name: pytorch-rocm-r9700
description: Daily PyTorch/ROCm base for AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 / RDNA4 / gfx1201. Built from ROCm/vLLM thin CI base, installs rocm[devel,libraries] + torch + torchvision from v2-staging/gfx120X-all, runs rocm-sdk init, and exports /opt/rocm-pytorch-constraints.txt for downstream vLLM builds.
